detailed_findings.api_contracts: All API endpoints follow expected contracts. Response structures match specifications.
detailed_findings.rbac: RBAC correctly implemented. Admin/manager have full access (view, create, update, run, dispose). Sales/warehouse correctly denied (403).
detailed_findings.validations: All validation rules working correctly (empty name, cost<=0, life<=0, salvage<0, salvage>=cost all return 400).
detailed_findings.depreciation: Straight-line depreciation working correctly. Monthly amount calculated as (cost-salvage)/life. Idempotency verified - rerun same period posts 0 and doesn't change accumulated.
detailed_findings.disposal: Both gain and loss scenarios working correctly. Gain: proceeds > book_value, result='gain', positive gain_loss. Loss: proceeds < book_value, result='loss', negative gain_loss. JE created for both.
detailed_findings.multi_entity: Entity scoping working correctly. Assets created in ent_ksc not visible in ent_kanda list. No IDOR vulnerability.
detailed_findings.gl_integrity: Trial balance balanced at 729,085,000 (debit == credit). 19 fixed asset JEs created (acquisition, depreciation, disposal). All required GL accounts exist (1-2900, 6-6000, 4-9100, 6-9500).
